purpose: Review durable integrity cases, quarantine recovery records and evidence-based session-boundary diagnostics without automatically repairing data.
primaryGoal: Inspect evidence, coordinate reviewed decisions and explicitly confirm reversible corrections in writable live mode.

dataSources.detail: Selected vehicle is forwarded to cases, statistics, quarantine and diagnostics. /data-repair intentionally disables the header vehicle picker (workspaceScope.ts:116), so the page-local VehicleSelect at line 32 is required, not a competing workspace selector.

Cursor lists and stats retain previous query data; lists/stats poll every 30 seconds and have 15-second staleTime. Detail enables only positive selected IDs and has 10-second staleTime. Reads forward AbortSignal. Query identities include scope/filters.

Suggestions are selected-vehicle scoped, explicitly refreshed and not polled. Stale sessions use a fleet query, poll every 30 seconds and are filtered by vehicle in RepairDiagnosticsWorkspace.tsx:43-52. Diagnostics mounts only on its active tab; lazy-module loading has a skeleton. Exact backend scan coverage, cutoff and result limits were not independently exercised.

Explicit operator-triggered mutations, live-mode flags, toast feedback and query invalidation/broadcast. Router applies sudo; scan has additional rate limiting. No mutation, scan or authentication prompt was invoked.

Drive path remains singular. Boundary inputs retain expected_stored_ended_at and reviewed RFC3339 timestamps, not browser-generated closure times. PUT/DELETE router mounts use the nested root path; trailing-slash behavior was not runtime tested. Shared client asserts operational write allowance and never-queued-offline rules at client.ts:378,392.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Cases and quarantine repeat cursor pagination, refresh warning, skeleton/table/empty structure (RepairQuarantinePanel.tsx:129-186). Forms also repeat finite-number parsing and input scaffolding. Existing RepairRefreshWarning, StaleSessionRow and RepairFormActions already consolidate important patterns.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Prefer existing composites; consider a feature-local cursor footer only when preserving distinct cursor/selection behavior. No speculative shared abstraction is required by this audit.

issues.detail: Read-only state is folded into bulkPending at RepairCaseWorkspace.tsx:177. Queue bulk buttons explain invalid status but do not receive writeBlockReason; operators have only the global write notice to explain this disabled state.
issues.fix: Forward canWrite/writeBlockReason separately and expose localized contextual explanation without adding a new tooltip/focus engine. Verify keyboard and screen-reader discoverability.

states.initialLoading: Lazy diagnostics fallback and per-source list/card skeletons exist; metrics use loading-aware SystemSummaryBrief.
states.empty: Queue/quarantine have localized filtered-empty messages. Suggestion and stale worklists have explicit EmptyState components.
states.fatalError: Independent QueryError and refetch controls avoid blanking unrelated sources.
states.refreshError: Diagnostics and drawer retain content through useDataState/StaleRefreshWarning. Queue/quarantine retain tables with RepairRefreshWarning.
states.partial: Diagnostics suggestions and stale sessions remain independent; suggestion response truncated flag has scope/callout disclosure.
states.offline: OperationalWriteNotice and canWrite protect writes, but list-specific paused state propagation is incomplete.

issues.detail: Header reconstructs a reduced query object from data/error/loading/busy/refetch, dropping dataUpdatedAt and fetchStatus from statisticsState already derived by its parent. Its StaleRefreshWarning cannot identify a paused offline refresh or last successful observation; the badge can still say Monitoring.
issues.fix: Pass the original typed statistics DataState or complete query metadata to the header; retain independent retry, last scan timestamp and source-specific freshness rather than treating last_scan_at as query observation time.

issues.rule: MDC-026 distinguish offline retained data from healthy data
issues.detail: Queue receives only fatalError/refreshError, not casesState.status/isRefreshBlocked/updatedAt. Quarantine derives full state but renders a refresh warning only for state.refreshError at RepairQuarantinePanel.tsx:138. Paused retained reads without an error therefore have no source-specific offline disclosure.
issues.fix: Reuse StaleRefreshWarning with the complete source state beside retained tables. Preserve rows, selections, retries and per-source loading/error behavior.

issues.rule: MDC-026/MDC-045 empty scope is not universal certainty
issues.detail: Suggestion empty messages assert every session in the scanned window agrees with durable history, even though response coverage can be truncated. StaleDriveWorklist.tsx:75 and StaleChargingWorklist.tsx:75 say all sessions are complete when this stale inventory is empty; that does not prove every session is complete.
issues.fix: Use existing localized scope-limited no-findings/no-stale-items messages, retaining truncation and scan scope context. Do not invent backend coverage or replace meaningful empty states.

visualIssues.detail: Decorative cyan gradient rule and cyan border/background/text icon tile at line 50 compete with semantic badges and the primary scan action. Generic diagnostic and suggestion icons also use fixed text-cyan-300. No text-neon, fixed-white/gray or glow patterns were found in the bounded scan.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface/border and theme-aware muted icon tokens for decoration, keeping warning/error/actionable evidence accents semantic. Do not reset saved theme or chart preferences. Effective light/dark contrast must be measured.

visualIssues.detail: High confidence is danger in the drawer but success in useRepairCaseColumns.tsx:80. Confidence strength and severity have different meanings, so the same source value produces opposing semantic colors.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse a consistent existing domain confidence presentation with textual High/Medium labels; reserve danger for actual severity/destructive impact, not confidence alone.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-032/MDC-046 scope identity and retained payload
architectureIssues.detail: Cases/quarantine/statistics use keepPreviousData across vehicle-key changes. The page consumes payload as hasData and does not distinguish isPlaceholderData or old scope. Filters reset in an effect, so the first render after vehicle selection may still use prior filters. Statistics can temporarily retain the previous vehicle's count under the new selected scope.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep existing caching policy but explicitly label prior-scope placeholder data and gate actions until current-scope data is established; reset scope-specific review state atomically. Coordinate canonical placeholder/scope provenance with the shared trust owner.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-032/MDC-046 review context survives only its source scope
architectureIssues.detail: Vehicle-change reset clears filters/history/selection/activeCaseId but not dismissIds or dismissReason; an open bulk-dismiss confirmation can therefore retain targets from the former scope. Quarantine scope reset at RepairQuarantinePanel.tsx:57 similarly leaves restoreTarget/restoreReason intact.
architectureIssues.fix: Clear or explicitly bind pending confirmations to original scope when vehicle changes; retain normal cancellation/reason behavior and prevent a dialog silently representing the new scope. Do not execute repair jobs to test this during audit.

architectureIssues.detail: Bulk-dismiss confirmation checks only reason, quarantine restore confirmation checks only reason (RepairQuarantinePanel.tsx:209), suggestion confirmation omits applyDisabled (RepairSuggestionCard.tsx:176-194), and manual confirmation omits disabled (RepairFormActions.tsx:203). An already open dialog can remain confirmable after operational mode becomes read-only. Client guards still reject forbidden writes; this is misleading UI parity, not evidence of an authorization bypass.
architectureIssues.fix: Propagate write/scope permission into every confirmation and handler guard, close stale review context where appropriate and retain block-reason explanation. Match the explicit canWrite guard already used in RepairCaseControlledActions.tsx:201.

priority.reason: Destructive/reversible operational workflow needs scope-safe review and accurate retained/offline trust before decorative modernization.

competingImplementations.detail: No competing layout, query, formatting, overlay or table implementation was established by the inspected page graph. Feature-local RepairRefreshWarning wraps canonical InlineCallout; it is not a second global error engine.
SystemSummaryBrief uses canonical OperationalBrief/useOperationalMetrics. Preserve the shared operational summary rather than rebuilding a KPI grid.

Local VehicleSelect is deliberate because /data-repair is a vehicle-disabled header route; no duplicate date selector is present. Independent repair-boundary date input is business data, not workspace range selection.
